Bhavnagar records state’s highest temperature:Two systems active, light rain forecast for 7 days; showers possible in Ahmedabad too
Rainfall of up to 11 mm was recorded across 11 talukas of Gujarat in the last 24 hours, while light showers were reported at isolated places in Botad, Dang and Navsari today (20 Aug) morning.
Bhavnagar recorded the highest temperature in the state at 34.2°C. With two weather systems currently active, the Meteorological Department has forecast light to moderate rainfall across Gujarat till August 26.
Two weather systems to keep rain conditions active
The depression over north Jharkhand and adjoining areas has moved west-northwest and weakened into a well-marked low-pressure area. Meanwhile, a cyclonic circulation has developed over northeast Rajasthan, which is expected to maintain rainy conditions in Gujarat.
Light to moderate rain is likely at isolated places in Sabarkantha, Aravalli, Kheda, Anand, Panchmahal, Dahod, Mahisagar, Banaskantha, Vav-Tharad, Patan, Mehsana, Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad.
Possibility of drizzle in Ahmedabad
Ahmedabad city will have cloudy weather and light rain or drizzle with thunder may occur. Today (20 Aug) in Ahmedabad, the maximum temperature was recorded at 33.5 degrees Celsius and the minimum temperature at 26.2 degrees Celsius.
Forecast of moderate rain in South Gujarat-Saurashtra
During August 24 to 26, the amount of rainfall may increase across entire North Gujarat. Rain showers may also occur at some places in Vadodara, Chota Udaipur, Narmada, Bharuch, Surat, Dang, Tapi, Navsari, Valsad as well as Daman and Dadra Nagar Haveli.
Light to moderate rain is likely at scattered places in Surendranagar, Rajkot, Jamnagar, Porbandar, Junagadh, Amreli, Bhavnagar, Morbi, Dwarka, Gir Somnath, Botad, Kutch and Diu.
